$comment: Reviewed exceptions for scripts/audit-gate.js. Every entry needs an advisory, the packages it covers, a justification, a mitigation, an owner and an expiry. Expired entries fail the gate. Do not add an entry to make CI green without a review.

exceptions.justification: The fix is zod 4.x, a major upgrade that changes the error API used by server.js (error.errors -> error.issues). openai is flagged only because it depends on zod; openai is used solely by backend/ai.js, which nothing imports.
exceptions.mitigation: express.json is capped at 256 KB and every array in the waitlist schema is bounded (areas_of_interest max 20), which removes the oversized constrained collection pattern the advisory describes.
exceptions.remediation: Upgrade to zod 4 in the canonical-backend workstream (ADR-002), when the PR #9 learning routes are rebased and their schemas are migrated together.
